title: Hasty Indian Manchego Bowl
description: A quick, creamy Indian bowl that fuses traditional lassi with crumbly Manchego, steamed vegetables, and aromatic spices.
instructions: Add grated cucumber, roasted cumin powder, lemon juice, sugar, salt, and black pepper; mix thoroughly.
Fold in grated Manchego cheese and chopped mint, stirring until cheese is evenly distributed.
Set aside the yogurt mixture; cover and refrigerate for 5 minutes to chill.
While the yogurt chills, steam the mixed veggies until just tender, about 5 minutes.
Drain the veggies and let them cool slightly, then chop into bite‑sized pieces.
Arrange the steamed veggies in the bottom of a serving bowl.
Spoon the chilled yogurt‑cheese mixture over the veggies, creating a layered effect.
Garnish with chopped cilantro if using, and drizzle a small amount of olive oil for extra moisture.
Serve immediately, optionally with a side of whole‑grain roti or rice.
